leakage_canary_gate.rule: Compute raw and symmetric ROC-AUC on strictly withheld truth vs active non-truth cells across every single candidate feature before model fitting. Any feature with symmetric AUC > 0.90 is quarantined as leakage until proven clean.

uniqueness_gate.reporting: Report BOTH literal forward/reverse/mutual overlap against all 1,089 rasters AND discriminating/informative (<70% 3-px halo footprint) + same-density like-for-like metrics.
